name: CharacterEval
intro: CharacterEval 是一个中文角色扮演对话智能体评测基准，包含 77 个来自中文小说和剧本的角色、1785 个多轮对话和 11376 个样本，用于系统评估角色一致性、对话能力与角色扮演吸引力。
org: Renmin University of China, Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications, Tianjin University, University of Electronic Science and Technology of China, KAUST
build_method: GPT-4初始对话提取, 人工质量控制, 百度百科角色档案补全
metric: Fluency, Coherency, Consistency, Knowledge Exposure/Accuracy/Hallucination, Persona Behavior/Utterance, Human-likeness, Communication Skills, Expression Diversity, Empathy, MBTI Accuracy
task_type: 角色扮演对话智能体评测
eval_feature: 多轮对话, 角色一致性, 情感价值
intro_en: CharacterEval is a Chinese benchmark for role-playing conversational agent assessment, covering 77 characters, 1,785 multi-turn dialogues, and 11,376 examples.
build_method_en: GPT-4 initial dialogue extraction, human-led quality control, Baidu Baike character-profile enrichment
metric_en: Fluency, Coherency, Consistency, Knowledge Exposure/Accuracy/Hallucination, Persona Behavior/Utterance, Human-likeness, Communication Skills, Expression Diversity, Empathy, MBTI Accuracy
eval_feature_en: Multi-turn Dialogue, Character Consistency, Emotional Engagement

drawio_review_note: Aligned with ACL 2024 paper 2024.acl-long.638 §§4–6.2 and official repository snapshot c3d44a6fc1790cc8c4b2fd7c01f0c72930655e0c. The diagram preserves all four collection principles; GPT-4 plot-twist segmentation and dialogue extraction; ABAB structure until a third character joins; more-than-five-turn filtering; and human coherence and quality review. The main construction path uses Baidu Baike profiles for knowledge, behavior, and speaking style. Personality Database contributes 54 ground MBTI labels only to a separate evaluation branch for the personality back-test; those labels are not part of profile enrichment or release construction. The paper headline reports 77 characters, 1,785 conversations, and 11,376 examples, but Table 1 lists train 6,811 plus test 4,564, which sums to 11,375; the diagram exposes this paper-internal mismatch instead of silently reconciling it. Twelve annotators sparsely score selected subjective metrics on a five-point scale to train Baichuan2-13B-base CharacterRM; MBTI accuracy remains a separate thirteenth metric. The fixed repository README reports 23,020 examples, while its public test_data.jsonl still contains the paper's 4,564 test examples, so the diagram intentionally represents the ACL paper version.
